text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day.
As I was looking something up in the library—

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Hyaah!?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
――Problem encountered. A large quantity of books has fallen to the floor.
Rice-san, I propose suspending data collection.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Ah-wawa...! I-I'm s-so sorry!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Scanning for injuries—pain perception, normal.
Status evaluated as 'unharmed'.
choice_data_list_en: Are you okay? Are you hurt?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Um... Rice is okay, too.
But...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I'm so sorry... It's all because Rice helped
gather materials that this happened.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Rice made everyone unhappy again...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Negative.
The cause of the book falling was this—

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Determined to be caused by excessively stacking 
all 50 volumes of 'The Bestest Friends☆Club'.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
This is an illustrated guide intended to
promote smooth communication.
choice_data_list: 『なかよし☆こよしちゃん倶楽部』？

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Currently verifying the true nature of this mysterious emotion.
Based on collected data,
I have determined this book to be optimal.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Yes. It occurs whenever the 'subject of interest'
enters my field of vision.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
—When she spots a 'target of interest' running on the track
and keeps eyes on it for over three seconds...
First, her heart rate spikes.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Next, my chest begins to heat up,
and my thoughts... well... become saturated
with a vague, mysterious emotion.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
From the above, I inferred that an error had occurred.
Upon reporting this to Father—

text_block_list.name: Bourbon's Father
text_block_list.text:
'—I see. You most likely want
to become closer with them.'

text_block_list.name: Bourbon's Father
text_block_list.text:
'Very well... Verify whether those feelings are genuine,
and report back to me.'

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
—And so, I have accepted the
'Friendship Mission' from my father.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Isn't that amazing?
To be thought of so fondly by Bourbon-san.
She must be a truly wonderful girl...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Um, well then... Rice is going to go now.
I don't want Rice's bad luck getting in the way of your research.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
A nuisance, you say?
For mission execution, the 'target of interest'—

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: In short, Rice-san is absolutely essential.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Whaaat?!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Query. Why are you surprised?
As you stated moments ago,
Rice-san is a 'wonderful girl.'

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Wh-Whaaat!? Wh-Wh-What!?
R-R-Rice is... st-stun...ning...!?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Wh-Whaaat!? Wh-Wh-What!?
R-R-Rice is... st-stun...ning...!?
choice_data_list: たしかに『素敵な子』だな！
たしかに『素敵な子』だね！
choice_data_list_en: She really is a "wonderful girl", isn't she!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Affirmation count increased.
Determining that the validity of my argument has risen.
choice_data_list: たしかに『素敵な子』だな！
たしかに『素敵な子』だね！
choice_data_list_en: She really is a "wonderful girl", isn't she!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Ah, ah, ah! B-but, um, that, Rice,
it's, it's, it's not nice at all...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Because bad things will happen if we're together!
So... I-I'm really happy, but—

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Rice isn't worthy of Bourbon-san!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Negative. Misfortune has not occurred
even once since the day I met you.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
In fact, without you, Rice-san,
the mission cannot proceed. ...In other words, that would be a problem.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Based on the above... Rice-san,
I request your cooperation in the 'Friendship Mission.'

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Wh-What should I do...? I don't want her to go through
anything bad, but—

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
—! Understood... Rice will help!
With the 'Friendship Mission'!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so... though a bit of awkwardness remained,
the two took steps toward each other
in order to become closer friends.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...Agitation detected from Rice-san.
If my remark was inappropriate, I apologize.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
N-N-No! That's not it,
Umm... I was just a little startled...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Pheeew... Calm down, calm down...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
U-um... I'm really happy, but...
I don't think someone like Rice is good enough.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Because if we're together, misfortune will follow.
Rice... isn't worthy of you, Bourbon-san.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Negative. Misfortune has not occurred
even once since the day I met you.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Wait... b-but... it could happen later on,
and cause trouble for you, you know?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
In fact, without you, Rice-san,
the mission cannot proceed.
In other words... that is what would truly be a problem.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Based on the above... Rice-san,
I request your cooperation in the 'Friendship Mission.'

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Wh-What should I do...? I don't want her to go through
anything bad, but—

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
—! Understood... Rice will help!
With the 'Friendship Mission'!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so... though a bit of awkwardness remained,
the two took steps toward each other
in order to become closer friends.
